##### Project general facts

Gateway Porto Al Zorah is a waterfront residential development of two contemporary buildings set along a calm creek. A minimalist interpretation of Mediterranean architecture gives the project a light, timeless character, with shaded terraces, soft forms and clean facades. Each building rises from a ground floor to eight residential floors around an internal courtyard brightened by skylights. The project offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts designed as duplexes for families seeking extra space.

Communal life is shaped around the water and the open landscape. A pool deck floating within the creek, complete with a lawn and a children's play area, creates a relaxing place to unwind and enjoy the surrounding vistas. Residents also have access to a swimming pool and a fully equipped gym, while the landscaped internal courtyard offers a calm, shaded setting for everyday moments. Covered parking and secure access add comfort and convenience for residents and their guests.

Airy yet shaded interiors are designed to blur the line between indoors and out, framing open views while keeping an intimate atmosphere. Floor-to-ceiling glass panes maximise natural light, and selected homes enjoy enclosed private patios. Noble flooring, simple yet sophisticated materials and a balanced, tasteful palette run through all living areas, complementing the natural surroundings. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Zorah City is an award-winning mixed-use coastal destination in Ajman, combining a long white sandy beachfront, an extensive waterfront and a calm creek that serves as a fish nursery for the coast. One of the oldest protected mangrove forests in the UAE is home to hundreds of resident and migratory bird species, while landscaped gardens and meandering pathways cover much of the community.

The Nicklaus Design championship golf course, The Oberoi Beach Resort and the Zoya Health and Wellbeing Resort sit within the community, alongside marinas and water sports facilities. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Dubai, Sharjah International Airport and Dubai International Airport, while Ajman City Centre, schools, universities and hospitals are a short drive away from home, and the marinas make the community easy to reach by boat.

Al Zorah City is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most distinctive coastal communities in the northern emirates. Creekside apartments with resort amenities appeal to families, professionals and holiday home buyers alike. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai, together with a mature lifestyle and leisure offer, support steady rental demand and long-term value for owners.
